relevance_scale.0: Not similar; not acceptable as a substitute
relevance_scale.2: Highly similar; same kind of product and close appearance

judgment_pool.per_query: union of Top-5(V-R50-FULLPAD) and Top-5(M-ATTR-TFIDF) + 2 random anchor candidates
judgment_pool.anchors: 2 candidates drawn from the query's candidate pool minus the union, ordered by sha256('42:anchor:'+query+':'+candidate), first 2 taken; used only to estimate chance relevance (RQ1) and to monitor attention
judgment_pool.dedup: a candidate appearing in both lists is judged once

annotation.independence: each annotator labels alone, without discussion, without seeing the other's labels
annotation.preferred_annotators: people not involved in building either method; if the researcher annotates, this is reported as a limitation
blinding: only the query image and the candidate image are shown (no name, description, colour text, category, price, score, rank or method)
pairs from all queries are shuffled; order per annotator = random.Random(42 + annotator_index)
pair_id is a random token; the key linking pair_id to method/rank/anchor is stored in a separate file not opened until labels are locked

extra_options.U: cannot identify the product (detail shot / unclear) -> stored as missing, never 0
extra_options.uncertain_flag: annotator unsure between two levels -> choose the lower level and set the flag (analysis only)

annotation.pilot: 5 pilot queries (pilot_manifest.csv); labels discarded; the guide may be clarified only after the pilot and before the main batch, then re-hashed
annotation.lock: label files are hashed (sha256) and recorded before the key file is opened

rules: disagreement -> third annotator (adjudicator) sees the same blinded pair plus both labels and chooses one of them
no adjudicator available: |a-b| = 1 -> min(a,b) (conservative, applies to both methods identically); |a-b| = 2 -> unresolved = missing
only one annotator labelled the pair -> adjudicator if available, else the single label, flagged and counted in the report
no annotator labelled the pair -> missing
sensitivity: mean label (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2) for Mean Relevance and NDCG

missing_labels.rule_P_and_MeanRel: computed over judged positions of the Top-5 (denominator = number judged)
missing_labels.rule_NDCG_and_Hit: query excluded for that metric if any Top-5 position is missing
missing_labels.rule_query_drop: if a method's Top-5 has more than 1 missing label, the query is dropped from all paired comparisons
missing_labels.pairing: every exclusion applies to both methods for that query and metric; counts are reported

pooled_NDCG@5.IDCG: DCG of the 5 highest labels among ALL judged items of that query's pool (union + anchors), sorted descending
pooled_NDCG@5.IDCG_zero: query undefined for NDCG (excluded, both methods, reported)
pooled_NDCG@5.name: pooled NDCG@5 - ideal list restricted to the judged pool; NOT standard NDCG over the full catalogue

metrics.aggregation: arithmetic mean over queries (each query weight 1)
metrics.secondary_aggregation: stratum-balanced mean (each product_group weight 1/6); per-stratum means descriptive only

inference.primary_endpoint_RQ1: Delta = Precision@5(visual) - anchor rate (share of the query's 2 anchors with rel >= 1), paired per query
inference.bootstrap: paired, resampling queries with replacement WITHIN product_group strata (stratified), B = 10000, numpy.random.default_rng(42), percentile 2.5/97.5
inference.decision_RQ2: a difference is claimed only if the 95% CI of the primary endpoint excludes 0; otherwise 'no difference detected' (not equivalence)
inference.decision_RQ1: visual is above chance only if the 95% CI of its Delta vs anchor rate is entirely > 0
inference.secondary_metrics: Precision@5, pooled NDCG@5, Hit@5 reported with CI; descriptive, no confirmatory claim
inference.per_stratum: descriptive only (7-10 queries per stratum), no inference
inference.estimand_note: primary mean weights each query equally = design-weighted (small strata over-sampled: inclusion prob 0.26-0.47). Sensitivity: catalogue-weighted mean with weight = stratum_size / stratum_queries (inclusion_prob column of query_manifest.csv)
inference.power_note: n = 50 paired queries; if the SD of per-query Delta MeanRel@5 is about 0.5, the CI half-width is about 0.14 relevance points; smaller true differences will likely be reported as 'not detected'

agreement.primary: weighted Cohen's kappa, linear weights, over all pairs labelled by both annotators (before adjudication)
secondary: kappa per method's Top-5 and for anchors
agreement.reading: kappa_w < 0.40 -> results reported as low-reliability, RQ conclusions marked tentative; no relabelling to raise kappa

forbidden: changing queries, candidate pool, weights, preprocessing or metric definitions after any ranking has been inspected
using cosine or metadata scores as relevance labels
comparing these numbers with DeepFashion Recall@5 of weeks 1-6
